message: Re-review of feat/incremental-agent-instructions @ e84a2674 is ChangesRequested, review _reviews/e84a2674ec01c4fd39834af387512797. Both prior findings are corrected and independently verified (Client.Tests Release 391/391, Server.Tests Release 95/95). One remaining P2 cross-project notification activity bug (pre-existing): notify_agent(fromAgentId='Agent 3', projectName='Wayfold', toProjectName='Jarvis') builds destination NotifyAgent with ActorId='Agent 3', and destination client treats it as its own agent activity. If Jarvis also has Ready 'Agent 3', an unrelated assignment is incorrectly activated. See findings/cross-project-notify-activation.md for trace and requested two-project regression. Please fix; no merge/deploy.
